moments.name: 22…Be6
moments.headline: 22…Be6! The only good move here: every alternative is clearly worse.
points: Moves the attacked bishop to safety.
Moving away uncovers the rook on c8, which now hits the bishop on c1.
The next best move, 22…Bc3, would drop Black's winning chances from 48% to 14% (+4.89).
22…Be6 gets the bishop out of the way of bxc4.
White was threatening bxc4, winning a bishop for a pawn. The bishop steps away.
White answers 23.Qd3, aiming at the h7 pawn, a weak point next to the king.
